name: Docs Automation

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      run_claude:
        description: 'Whether to run Claude Code'
        required: true
        default: false
        type: boolean
      create_pr:
        description: 'Whether to create PR in docs-new'
        required: true
        default: false
        type: boolean

        description: 'Max Claude turns (increase if hitting limit)'
        required: true
        default: 50
        type: number

jobs:
  docs-automation:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - name: Checkout InstantSearch repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run Claude Code
        if: ${{ inputs.run_claude }}
        env:
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          npx claude-code --max-turns ${{ inputs.max_turns }}

      - name: Checkout docs-new repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: algolia/docs-new
          token: $
